findings.evidence: 5 of 240 query rows have no search-results record
findings.required_fix: one current terminal-for-run ledger row for every frozen query_attempt_id

findings.evidence: legacy completion key contains candidate_year_id and query_variant only
findings.required_fix: hash sample, candidate/contest, exact query/version, provider, gl, hl, and num into query_attempt_id

findings.evidence: 16 of 49 eligible source-page keys are absent from expansion output; all 16 are retained date-conflict leads
findings.required_fix: preserve a terminal fetch-attempt row for every selected result claim

findings.evidence: legacy direct-domain and evidence rules can pass surname plus city/mayor context
findings.required_fix: require legal-first-or-nickname plus surname for candidate attribution

findings.evidence: legacy candidate-shaped-domain logic ignores identity and campaign signals in URL paths
findings.required_fix: classify exact custom-domain, candidate-subdomain, and shared-host-path leads separately

findings.evidence: legacy lead deduplication collapses 1 result-level claim(s) in the frozen pilot
findings.required_fix: retain result_claim_id and url_claim_id; group only through a separate url_entity_id

findings.evidence: the same frozen flattened results contain 528 stored source_evidence labels but current rescoring yields 50
findings.required_fix: retain and reason-code every organic result row under a frozen classifier version

findings.evidence: legacy JSONL stores selected organic fields, not the complete provider response and response hash
findings.required_fix: freeze the complete raw response and SHA-256 before flattening organic rows

findings.evidence: legacy host exclusion is used for candidate URLs but does not express evidence-page eligibility independently
findings.required_fix: separate candidate coverage URL type from source-page fetch eligibility

findings.evidence: 32 of 480 frozen names contain quoted nicknames that the old exact-phrase sanitizer combines with legal names
findings.required_fix: use one legal-name/nickname OR group in the single approved query

findings.evidence: legacy primary query includes both ungrouped terms, narrowing source-page recall
findings.required_fix: use (campaign OR website) while retaining candidate, mayor, city, state, and year

findings.evidence: 3 of 480 frozen candidate names contain recoverable encoding damage
findings.required_fix: preserve the raw name, deterministically repair query text, flag the repair, and fail if damage remains

findings.evidence: 1 case-only URL change(s) observed between raw-result reconstruction and stored queue
findings.required_fix: preserve raw URL and exact normalized URL separately; never lowercase path/query

scope: offline audit of frozen Serper/search pilot for the approved 480-case one-query wave
